title: kbmon's sprint estimate reads a running paid bench item's own progress, run N of M
goal: bench_multi.progress(DIR) gives the runs done and planned of a running multi sandbox from its results.jsonl and plan; mon_eta.estimate counts a paid bench item in progress by the runs it has left at its kind's minutes per run

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bench_multi; sys.exit(0 if hasattr(bench_multi,"progress") else 1)

notes: Operator request 2026-10-19 ("ensure more accurate timeframing"), design point 2: a paid bench item uses its own progress, run N of M. Parked at the plan of SP-yjfiemha (gate bench-progress of ST-po5rwymx): no reader of a running bench's progress exists (bench_multi has no progress function, and nothing records which sandbox a running item uses), and the paid sprint SP-3pvz2noj holds bench_multi.py until it closes.
